profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman Information Systems
profile.summary:
- Software Engineer with more than 13 years of experience in large scale software development. Participate in full software development cycle including software requirements analysis, detailed design, code development, integration, testing and verification.
- Very familiar with Embedded Software Development, Multi Threaded Applications, Object Oriented design using UML, Graphics User Interface (GUI) and Database Client/Server applications. Proficient in C/C++, C#, and Oracle PL/SQL under Unix/Linux or Windows platform.  
- Self motivated and hard working. Work well in team or independent environment, adapt quickly to new environment. Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills. Exceptional multi-tasking capabilities with effective time management techniques.
- U.S. Citizen with active DoD Secret Clearance.

Specialties: Software Development and Integration, C++, Embedded Software programming, Multi-Threaded programming, Oracle DB Client/Server applications, Oracle PL/SQL stored procedure, CORBA, OOAD, UML and GUI development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop software for the Ground-Base Midcourse Defense (GMD) program. Work for the Command and Launch Equipment (CLE) Database group. Specific responsibilities include:
- Maintain, update, and implement new capabilities for the CLE Database service. The CLE Database service provides the interfaces for the CLE software to write or read data to and from Oracle database. The CLE Database service is implemented using C++ and Oracle Pro C/C++ 
- Maintain, update, and implement various Oracle PL/SQL stored procedures, embedded SQL code, and Perl scripts to support the CLE Admin Tool. The CLE Admin Tool provides the capabilities to modify, view, and configure various configurations and data of the CLE software. The CLE Admin Tool also provides the capability to archive and purge various log files that generated by the CLE software.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop software for Joint Tactical Radio System (JTRS) Ground Mobile Radio (GMR) program. Specific responsibilities include:
- Responsible for design, development, and testing for Configuration Application Service. The Configuration Application was used with the Software Loader Verifier Application (SLVA) to transfer of files into and out of the JTRS.  In addition, the Configuration Application also participates in the transfer of files into and out of the JTRS Wideband Networking Waveform (JWNM). The Configuration Application is designed using Object Oriented and is implemented using C++ on Integrity Real Time Operating System.
- Responsible for design, development, and testing for IP Router Service. The IP Router Service provides the core network capabilities in the JTR using Linux Environment running on the INTEGRITY Real Time Operating System. A Linux kernel (version 2.6.18) is customized to keep only the necessary services such as network services, file system services, and device driver services to handle the network routing for the JTR.
- Responsible for design, development, and testing for the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) Service. The SNMP Service is implemented using Net-SNMP with SNMPv3 for Linux platform. Standard SNMP protocols such as SNMPGet, SNMPGetNext, SNMPSet, SNMPWalk are used to handle SNMP requests from external devices. For the current version of the JTR, only standard MIBs are available for request.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participate in all phases of the software development cycle of applications used for system integration and test of the Command and Launch Equipment (CLE) Software for the Ground-Base Midcourse Defense (GMD) Program. Specific responsibilities include: 
- Lead a team of 3 developers to design and develop the TCLT (Test CLE Log Tool) using Oracle Form 6i on UNIX platform. Designed and developed various Stored Procedures & PL/SQL functions for TCLT to generate reports, archive, sort, filter, compare, calculate and track data based on user inputs. 
- Design and develop various embedded SQL code to interface with Oracle database using Oracle Pro C/C++ Pre-compiler. The CLE software uses these interfaces to write or read data to and from the Oracle database. 
- Designed and develop various multi threaded simulation software with GUI to support the testing of the CLE software. This simulation software provides user capabilities to create different scenarios to configure and test the CLE software. All designs are Object Oriented using UML method. The simulation software is written in C++ on UNIX platform. Communication interfaces are implemented using TCP/IP protocol and Orbix. User interfaces are implemented with Motif 2.1 using Builder Xcessory.
